props.heading: Your blessed journey begins here

props.label: About Us
props.heading: Serving pilgrims with care, trust and dedication
props.body:
Embark on your sacred journey with Jamal Tours Solutions. We provide complete Hajj and Umrah packages with visa assistance, flight bookings, hotel accommodation, transportation and guided pilgrimage services.

Our experienced team handles the arrangements end to end — the documentation, the departures, the hotels near the Haram, the buses for Ziyarat — so that a first-time pilgrim is never left working out logistics in an unfamiliar country.

We run monthly Umrah departures from Mumbai, Nagpur, Hyderabad and other cities, and we arrange Baghdad Ziyarat separately or combined with Umrah in a single itinerary.

Our priority is a comfortable, hassle-free and spiritually fulfilling experience. Come to the office at Taj Bagh, or message us on WhatsApp and we will talk you through what is available for your dates.

props.termsBody: Package prices, departure dates and inclusions are confirmed in writing at the time of booking and are subject to airline fares, hotel availability and prevailing exchange rates. Visa issuance is decided solely by the authorities of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (and, for Ziyarat itineraries, by the relevant authorities of the destination country); we assist with the application and documentation but cannot guarantee approval, and government fees are non-refundable once submitted. Pilgrims are responsible for holding a valid passport with sufficient validity, for meeting all health and vaccination requirements in force at the time of travel, and for complying with the regulations of the destination country. items.q: What does a package include?
items.a: Typically air fare, visa processing, hotel accommodation, transport within Saudi Arabia, local Ziyarat by AC bus, Indian meals and a guide with the group. Exactly what is included depends on the package, and we set it out in writing before you pay anything.

items.q: Which cities do you depart from?
items.a: We arrange departures from Mumbai, Nagpur, Hyderabad and other cities depending on the month. Tell us where you would prefer to fly from and we will tell you what is available for your dates.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: For Umrah, a month is usually comfortable. For Hajj, considerably longer — quota and visa timelines are set by the authorities, so start the conversation early rather than close to the season.

items.q: Can you handle the visa if I book only that?
items.a: Yes. Visa assistance, air ticketing, hotel booking and insurance can each be arranged on their own if you are putting the rest of the journey together yourself.

items.q: Is the visa guaranteed?
items.a: No, and be cautious of anyone who says otherwise. Visa issuance is decided by the Saudi authorities. We prepare and submit the application correctly and keep you updated, but the decision is not ours to make.

items.q: Are the hotels near the Haram?
items.a: We select hotels with the walk to the Haram in mind, and we will tell you the realistic walking distance rather than a marketing figure. If the group includes elderly pilgrims, tell us and we will factor that in.

items.q: Do you take groups from the same family or community?
items.a: Yes, and it is a large part of what we do. Give us the group size and preferred month and we will put together an itinerary and a written quotation.

props.heading: Planning your journey?
props.sub: Message us on WhatsApp with your preferred month and group size, and we will send the current packages and what each one includes.
